title: Restriction coherence of the explicit target sheaf comparison
statement: Let Λ be a commutative ring, p:X→S and g:T→S arbitrary scheme morphisms, q an integer, and F an étale Λ-module sheaf on T. For U over T, construct the canonical comparison C_U from the base-change target sheaf for U×_S X to the higher image of the fixed sheaf G=pr_T^*F on U×_T(T×_S X). Specifically C_U is baseChangeTargetFunctorIso followed by higherDirectImageTransition along the explicit pullback-associativity isomorphism, followed by the higher-image map of the upperStarComp coefficient isomorphism. For any φ:U→V over T, the baseChangeTargetTransition for φ followed by its coefficient identification and C_U equals C_V followed by higherDirectImageOverMap for Over.pullback(pr_T)(φ). The transitions are those of [def-sbc-canonical-base-change-stalk-transitions] and [def-sbc-module-higher-image-transitions], and the coefficient inverse images are [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image]. This is a sheaf morphism equality; it contains neither a stalk functor nor an existential assertion.

source.place: Tag 0F07 (lemma-go-down-to-field), restriction square and coefficient identification preceding condition (2); Tag 09Z1, canonical restriction maps.

proof.text: Construct the single-pullback lift a of φ and the iterated-pullback map b. The explicit comparisons cU and cV obey cU≫a=b≫cV: check projections to V and X and apply pullback uniqueness. The four triangles over X and the coefficient structure maps commute by pullback.lift_fst, pullback.lift_snd and Over.w.

The explicit coefficient comparison square is upperStar_coefficient_square with the actual pullback projection arrows and the just-proved scheme equalities. This proves the supplied coefficient hypothesis of higherDirectImage_coefficient_square.

Normalize baseChangeTargetTransition, including the final coefficient identification, using baseChangeTargetTransition_higherImage. Expand the hom of the unchanged explicit target comparison using the proved comparison_hom API. The lower-star transition is invertible as before; higherDirectImageTransition_isIso_of_lower packages the isomorphism inference without unfolding derived constructions.

Apply higherDirectImage_coefficient_square to the actual arrows a,b,cV,cU and the coefficient square. Paste this equality with target-transition normalization and the two comparison_hom equalities by abstract-category associativity. The final coefficient-decorated transition is exactly higherDirectImageOverMap. This proves the original statement for every integer q. The coefficient-map API keeps the higher-image endpoint objects consistent. Its OverMap equation supplies the last pasting hypothesis. The pasting theorem is instantiated explicitly at the endpoint objects and arrows of the proved equalities; Lean checks the resulting term, without transports of the derived-functor objects.
